$comment: Frozen 2026-10-27: what each shipped query template rendered before templates gained a set parameter. A saved query whose params lack the set parameter must regenerate byte-identically to these. crosswalk-density-by-framework is deliberately absent: it moved from a folder filter to kind == crosswalk-edge.

cases.expected:
filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("_crosswalker/mappings/csf-to-800-53")
    - 'confidence >= 0.7'
    - or:
        - predicate_modifier.isEmpty()
        - 'predicate_modifier != "NOT"'
views:
  - type: crosswalker-pivot
    name: "NIST CSF → 800-53 coverage matrix"
    config:
      rowsBy: "subject_id"
      colsBy: "object_id"
      cellOp: "count"
      empty: "gap"
      heatmap: true

filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("_crosswalker/mappings/csf-to-mitre")
    - 'confidence >= 0.7'
    - or:
        - predicate_modifier.isEmpty()
        - 'predicate_modifier != "NOT"'
views:
  - type: crosswalker-pivot
    name: "NIST CSF → MITRE ATT&CK coverage"
    config:
      rowsBy: "subject_id"
      colsBy: "object_id"
      cellOp: "count"
      empty: "gap"
      heatmap: true

filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("_crosswalker/mappings/csf-to-mitre")
    - 'confidence >= 0.5'
    - or:
        - predicate_modifier.isEmpty()
        - 'predicate_modifier != "NOT"'
    - 'tactic == "Persistence"'
views:
  - type: crosswalker-pivot
    name: "NIST CSF → MITRE ATT&CK coverage"
    config:
      rowsBy: "subject_id"
      colsBy: "object_id"
      cellOp: "count"
      empty: "gap"
      heatmap: true

filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("Frameworks/CIS-Controls-v8")
views:
  - type: list
    name: "CIS Controls by family"
    order:
      - family
      - id

filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("Frameworks/CIS-Controls-v8")
    - 'family == "AC"'
views:
  - type: list
    name: "CIS Controls by family"
    order:
      - family
      - id

filters:
  and:
    - file.inFolder("Frameworks/MITRE-ATT&CK")
views:
  # Hierarchy renderer ships in v0.1.7-v0.1.8 — Bases falls back to
  # table view until then. The data + structure are correct; only the
  # custom visualization is "renderer coming soon".
  - type: table
    name: "MITRE ATT&CK tactic → technique hierarchy"
    order:
      - tactic
      - parent
      - id
      - title

filters:
  and:
    - 'kind == "junction-note"'
    - 'predicate == "has_evidence"'
    - 'status == "approved"'
    - or:
        - 'coverage == "full"'
        - 'coverage == "partial"'
views:
  - type: table
    name: "Approved evidence links by control"
    order:
      - subject
      - object
      - coverage
      - review_date
    summaries:
      subject: Count
